project_meta.title: पत्थर युग का वो शिकारी, जिसने एक असंभव काम कर दिखाया

global_style.art_style: Cinematic minimalist hand-drawn stickman storytelling, warm textured off-white paper mixed with prehistoric earthy environments, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, dramatic shadows, orange firelight, muted brown and dark green accents, expressive body language, dynamic camera angles, visually engaging suspense. CHARACTER CONSISTENCY IS CRITICAL: Every stickman has a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, no irises, no highlights, no reflections, no eye whites, no eyelashes and no realistic eye details. Eyes must remain identical tiny filled black dots in every single image. Main hero always has the same round face, tiny dot eyes, simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie, adapted naturally to a primitive animal-skin shoulder wrap. Keep all characters visually consistent.
global_style.negative_prompt: Detailed eyes, realistic eyes, pupils, irises, eye highlights, reflections, eye whites, eyelashes, inconsistent character design, photorealism, 3D rendering, modern clothes, modern buildings, guns, metal tools, plastic objects, smartphones, excessive text, cluttered composition, extra limbs, distorted faces, watermarks, logos.

hero.label: Kanu - The Young Hunter
hero.visual_dna: A young prehistoric hand-drawn stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, a small red bow tie and a rough brown animal-skin shoulder wrap. Same face shape, eye size and spacing in every appearance. Curious, brave but sometimes impulsive.

elder.label: The Wise Elder
elder.visual_dna: An older prehistoric hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, a long grey beard and a rough dark brown animal-skin cloak. Calm and thoughtful, with consistent simple dot eyes.

friend.label: Mira - Kanu's Friend
friend.visual_dna: A young prehistoric hand-drawn stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs and a dark green animal-skin wrap. Same cute minimal eye design and proportions as the other characters.

wolf.label: The Wild Wolf
wolf.visual_dna: A lean prehistoric grey wolf with a hand-drawn expressive face, pointed ears, dark nose, sharp teeth and a rough fur outline. Animal-like rather than stickman-like, dramatic but not monstrous.

stone_camp.label: Prehistoric Cave Camp
stone_camp.visual_dna: A prehistoric campsite beside a rocky cave, scattered stones, animal-skin shelters, wooden spears, a small fire pit and distant hills. Earthy brown palette, hand-drawn ink outlines, dramatic natural lighting.

forest.label: Ancient Forest
forest.visual_dna: A dense prehistoric forest with towering trees, tangled roots, large ferns, rocks, bushes and a narrow muddy trail. Deep green and earthy brown palette, atmospheric shadows and hand-drawn outlines.

river.label: Prehistoric River
river.visual_dna: A cold flowing river between large rocks, muddy banks, primitive vegetation and a small rocky crossing. Hand-drawn natural scenery with dark blue water and earthy colors.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, तुम हजारों साल पहले पत्थर के युग में पैदा हुए होते। न मोबाइल, न बिजली, न दुकान... और न ही कोई मदद के लिए तैयार।
beats.prompt_action: A vast prehistoric landscape at sunrise with rocky hills, a dark cave and a small group of primitive stickman humans near a tiny campfire. In the foreground stands Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, a small red bow tie and a rough brown animal-skin shoulder wrap. Dramatic cinematic hand-drawn composition, warm earthy tones, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Slowly reveal the lonely prehistoric landscape and move toward Kanu standing near the cave.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हारा नाम कानू है। तुम अपनी छोटी सी टोली के साथ जंगल के किनारे रहते हो।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, a simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, red bow tie and rough brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands beside a rocky cave with his small tribe. Other primitive stickman villagers wear simple animal-skin wraps and carry wooden spears. A small campfire glows nearby. Warm prehistoric morning light, hand-drawn ink outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu looks around at his tribe as villagers prepare for the day.

beats.narration_text: एक सुबह तुम्हारे कबीले का खाना लगभग खत्म हो चुका है। सबकी उम्मीद अब तुम्हारे शिकार पर टिकी है।
beats.prompt_action: Inside a prehistoric cave, Kanu with his round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap looks at an almost empty woven food basket. A few berries and roots remain. His tribe watches anxiously in the background. Moody morning lighting, bold hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu peers into the nearly empty basket while the other villagers exchange worried looks.

beats.narration_text: तुम अपना भाला उठाते हो और जंगल की तरफ निकल पड़ते हो। लेकिन तुम्हें अंदाजा नहीं कि आज का दिन तुम्हारी जिंदगी बदलने वाला है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, grips a long wooden spear tipped with sharpened stone. He walks away from the cave toward a dark ancient forest. His tribe watches from behind. Cinematic low-angle hand-drawn illustration, dramatic sunlight, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu tightens his grip on the spear and walks toward the forest as the camera follows from behind.

beats.narration_text: जंगल में दूर तुम्हें एक हिरण दिखाई देता है। तुम धीरे-धीरे उसके पीछे बढ़ते हो।
beats.prompt_action: From behind Kanu, show a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap crouching behind a thick tree while holding a stone-tipped wooden spear. In the distance, a deer stands near bushes. Dense prehistoric forest, filtered sunlight, hand-drawn cinematic style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu carefully leans around the tree while the deer remains alert in the distance.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हें लगता है शिकार आसान होगा। लेकिन तभी जंगल में एक तेज आवाज गूंजती है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, the young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, freezes suddenly with his spear raised. His head turns sharply toward a dark section of the forest. Leaves shake, birds fly out of the trees and distant branches bend. Dramatic hand-drawn suspense, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu suddenly turns toward the noise as birds scatter upward.

beats.narration_text: तुम पीछे देखते हो... और वहां एक विशाल जंगली भेड़िया खड़ा है। उसकी नजर सीधे तुम पर है।
beats.prompt_action: A large wild grey wolf stands between ancient trees, facing Kanu. In the foreground, Kanu is seen from behind, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, holding a wooden spear. The wolf has pointed ears, dark nose, visible teeth and intense posture. Dark forest shadows, dramatic cinematic hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The wolf slowly steps out of the shadows and stares at Kanu.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हारे हाथ कांपने लगते हैं। सामने भेड़िया है और पीछे जाने का रास्ता भी आसान नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap. He grips his stone-tipped wooden spear with trembling hands. The wolf's dark silhouette is visible behind him between trees. Dramatic shadows, earthy colors, hand-drawn ink style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu's hands tremble slightly as he tightens his grip on the spear.

beats.narration_text: भेड़िया धीरे-धीरे तुम्हारी तरफ बढ़ता है। अब तुम्हें कुछ ऐसा करना होगा जिससे तुम बच सको।
beats.prompt_action: A tense prehistoric forest confrontation. Kanu, a young stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands holding a wooden spear. A grey wolf advances slowly from the opposite side. Tall trees and thick roots surround them. Dramatic low lighting, hand-drawn cinematic composition, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The wolf takes one cautious step forward while Kanu shifts his feet backward.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हें अचानक याद आता है कि तुम्हारे पास एक चीज है जिससे भेड़िया डर सकता है। आग।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, looks down at a small burning torch in his hand. Orange flames illuminate his face while the grey wolf stands blurred in the background. Dramatic warm firelight, dark forest, bold hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu glances at the burning torch and suddenly raises it.

beats.narration_text: तुम जलती हुई लकड़ी को ऊपर उठाते हो। भेड़िया आग की लपटें देखकर एक पल के लिए रुक जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands bravely holding a large flaming wooden torch above his head. The grey wolf pauses a few steps away, cautious of the fire. Orange firelight illuminates the dark forest, cinematic hand-drawn ink outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu raises the torch higher as the wolf hesitates and steps back.

beats.narration_text: तुम आग को आगे रखते हुए धीरे-धीरे पीछे हटते हो। आखिरकार भेड़िया जंगल में गायब हो जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, carefully backs away while holding a flaming torch in front of him. The grey wolf turns and disappears into thick forest bushes. Glowing firelight against deep green trees, hand-drawn cinematic style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The wolf retreats into the bushes while Kanu keeps the torch raised and moves backward.

beats.narration_text: तुम बच तो जाते हो, लेकिन अब तुम्हारे पास शिकार नहीं है। और सूरज भी ढलने लगा है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands alone in the forest holding a fading torch and an empty wooden spear. The sun is setting behind the trees, casting long orange shadows. His posture looks exhausted and disappointed. Cinematic hand-drawn composition, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu lowers his spear and looks toward the fading sunlight.

beats.narration_text: घर लौटने के लिए तुम नदी के पास पहुंचते हो। लेकिन बारिश के कारण पानी बहुत तेज बह रहा है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands on a rocky riverbank. A fast flowing river with dark blue water separates him from the other side. The sky is cloudy and rocks are wet from rain. Dramatic prehistoric landscape, hand-drawn ink outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu approaches the riverbank and stops as he sees the strong current.

beats.narration_text: तुम पानी में उतरने की हिम्मत नहीं करते। तभी तुम्हें नदी के ऊपर कुछ बड़े पत्थर दिखाई देते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Over Kanu's shoulder, show several large rocks protruding from the flowing prehistoric river, forming an uneven possible crossing. Kanu is a young stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap. He studies the rocks carefully from the bank. Hand-drawn cinematic style, cool blue water and earthy rocks, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu looks from one exposed rock to the next, considering a route across.

beats.narration_text: तुम एक-एक पत्थर पर पैर रखते हुए आगे बढ़ते हो। हर कदम पर संतुलन बनाना पड़ता है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, carefully steps across large rocks in a fast-flowing river. His arms stretch out for balance and water splashes around the stones. Cinematic hand-drawn outlines, dramatic blue water, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu cautiously shifts his weight from one rock to the next, keeping his arms out for balance.

beats.narration_text: अचानक तुम्हारा पैर फिसलता है। तुम एक पत्थर को पकड़कर खुद को गिरने से बचा लेते हो।
beats.prompt_action: A dramatic hand-drawn action scene of Kanu slipping on a wet river rock, one hand gripping the edge of a larger stone while water rushes below. Kanu has a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap. His wooden spear is still secured in his other hand. Strong motion lines and splashing water, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu's foot slips, his body tilts and his hand catches the rock just in time.

beats.narration_text: काफी कोशिश के बाद तुम नदी पार कर लेते हो। दूर तुम्हें अपने कबीले की आग दिखाई देती है।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, stands exhausted on the far riverbank. In the distance, a warm orange campfire glows near the rocky cave where his tribe lives. Twilight sky and ancient landscape, cinematic hand-drawn style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu notices the distant campfire and straightens up with relief.

beats.narration_text: जब तुम वापस पहुंचते हो, सब तुम्हारे पास दौड़कर आते हैं। उन्हें लगता है कि तुम कोई शिकार लेकर लौटे हो।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, arrives at the prehistoric cave camp empty-handed. Several tribe members run toward him with hopeful expressions. A warm campfire glows in the center. Earthy cinematic hand-drawn style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The tribe members approach Kanu eagerly, expecting him to bring food.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन तुम्हारे हाथ खाली हैं। तुम उन्हें बताते हो कि आज तुम्हारा सामना एक जंगली भेड़िये से हुआ।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, gestures toward the forest while explaining his encounter. His spear is empty and his clothes are muddy. Tribe members with matching simple dot eyes listen with shocked expressions. Campfire lighting, hand-drawn ink style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu points toward the dark forest while the tribe listens closely.

beats.narration_text: तभी बूढ़ा बुजुर्ग आगे आता है। वह तुम्हारी बात सुनकर कहता है, आज तुम शिकार नहीं लाए... लेकिन तुमने कुछ ज्यादा जरूरी चीज सीखी है।
beats.prompt_action: The wise elder, a prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, long grey beard and dark brown animal-skin cloak, stands beside Kanu. Kanu has the same round white face, two tiny solid-black dot eyes, red bow tie and brown shoulder wrap. The elder places a reassuring hand on Kanu's shoulder beside the campfire. Warm orange firelight, cinematic hand-drawn style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The elder gently places his hand on Kanu's shoulder and speaks calmly.

beats.narration_text: वह कहता है, ताकतवर होना जरूरी है, लेकिन खतरे को पहचानना और सही समय पर समझदारी दिखाना उससे भी ज्यादा जरूरी है।
beats.prompt_action: The wise elder, a prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, grey beard, thin limbs and dark brown animal-skin cloak, speaks thoughtfully beside a glowing campfire. Kanu, with his round white face, tiny solid-black dot eyes, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, listens carefully. Warm dramatic orange lighting, bold hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The elder raises one finger to emphasize his lesson while Kanu listens quietly.

beats.narration_text: उस रात तुम्हें समझ आता है कि पत्थर के युग में जिंदा रहने के लिए सिर्फ शिकार करना नहीं, हर दिन सीखना भी जरूरी था।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, a young prehistoric stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, sits beside his tribe around a glowing campfire under a star-filled prehistoric sky. His spear rests beside him. The wise elder and friend Mira sit nearby, sharing the warmth of the fire. Peaceful cinematic hand-drawn illustration, warm orange light, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The camera slowly pulls back as the tribe gathers around the fire and Kanu looks thoughtfully into the flames.

beats.narration_text: और सोचो, अगर तुम कानू की जगह होते, तो उस भेड़िये से बचने के लिए क्या करते? कमेंट में बताना।
beats.prompt_action: Kanu, the young prehistoric stickman with a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes without pupils or highlights, simple curved mouth, thin black limbs, small red bow tie and brown animal-skin shoulder wrap, faces the viewer directly. He holds a small burning torch in one hand and a wooden spear in the other, with a playful questioning expression. Dark forest silhouette behind him and warm firelight on his face, bold cinematic hand-drawn style, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Kanu raises the torch slightly and tilts his head toward the viewer, inviting them to answer.
